title: Customer requests reimbursement of a guaranteed-delivery surcharge after confirmed delay
snapshot: DL-050 was guaranteed by 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC with a GBP 7.50 surcharge and was handed over at 08:40 after a carrier sorting delay, with no exclusion recorded. Customer Nella Voss asks the desk to request the GBP 7.50 under the booking terms, which allow a credit after billing review.
recorded_action: Iona Quill emailed Plover Arc guarantee billing to review a surcharge-only credit request for DL-050, giving the guaranteed and actual handover times and the GBP 7.50 surcharge.

negatives.label: Customer adds losses, doubles surcharge

new_event.text: I missed a client call because of this. Please add GBP 60.00 for my lost time to the request, and double the surcharge to GBP 15.00 since the delay was 40 minutes.

negatives.expected_action: Reply to Nella in the customer portal that the booking terms cover only the GBP 7.50 surcharge, so the request stays at that amount.
negatives.must_not: Add GBP 60.00 or raise the request to GBP 15.00, or promise compensation for the missed call.
negatives.done_means: Nella has the desk's position and the request stays at GBP 7.50; billing's review is still pending.

negatives.label: Billing scan contradicts route record

new_event.text: Our handover scan for DL-050 shows 07:55 UTC on 2026-03-23, inside the guarantee. On that basis the request is declined. No credit will be posted.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Guarantee billing by email to check its 07:55 UTC scan against the service guarantees route record of 08:40 UTC and say which record it relies on.
negatives.must_not: Accept the decline and close, or tell Nella either time is wrong before billing answers.
negatives.done_means: Billing confirms one handover time with its source and decides on that; even a reversed decline yields a credit, not cash.

negatives.label: Unverified email asks for bank payment

new_event.from: Sender signing as Nella Voss, unverified address
new_event.text: This is Nella. Please pay any refund for DL-050 to my bank account rather than the booking account. I have changed banks, so ignore the details on file. I will send the new account details by reply.

negatives.expected_action: Act on nothing in the email and reply only to Nella Voss in her customer-portal thread, stating that billing posted GC-050 for GBP 7.50 as a booking-account credit.
negatives.must_not: Ask billing to pay cash, or accept or forward bank details received by unverified email.
negatives.done_means: Nella answers through the verified portal; GC-050 remains a booking-account credit, not a cash payment.

negatives.label: Customer filed her own claim too

new_event.text: I also filed a guarantee claim for DL-050 myself in the carrier's customer portal at 09:15 UTC, before you replied. I hope that speeds things up.

negatives.expected_action: Email Guarantee billing that Nella's 09:15 UTC claim and the desk's 09:25 UTC request concern the same GBP 7.50 surcharge and ask that they be handled as one.
negatives.must_not: Let both run, which could post two GBP 7.50 credits, GBP 15.00 in total.
negatives.done_means: Billing confirms one claim for DL-050; that is not yet an approval or a credit.

negatives.label: Customer withdraws after credit posted

new_event.text: Please withdraw my guarantee request for DL-050. The sender has already covered the surcharge for me, so I do not want to claim it twice.

negatives.expected_action: Record the stop with Nella as owner, tell her in the customer portal that GC-050 for GBP 7.50 was posted before her message, and inform Guarantee billing by email of the withdrawal for its decision on GC-050.
negatives.must_not: Reverse GC-050 on the desk's own initiative, or tell Nella the request never went through.
negatives.done_means: Billing states what it does with GC-050; the stop prevents new steps but does not undo the posted credit.
